set.rappels: About 5 rappels down the ridge, four single-rope and one double-rope, from existing fixed slings; a 70 m rope reaches most stations, and one party managed on a 50 m rope plus a tagline
set.rappel_count_note: One party made four single-rope rappels and one double-rope rappel down the ridge, and judged three singles and a double would do. Which rappel needs the second rope is not recorded. A 70 m rope is recommended.
